hook: I want every travel disruption to come with a clear next step

builtFor.context: Duffel is rebuilding travel's infrastructure, and disruptions are where it's tested: airline rules, payments and anxious travellers collide. The AI support product decides what happens next for both the seller and the traveller.

opportunities.title: Change Desk
opportunities.body: Every airline change, sorted by urgency and labelled by what the seller can do.

opportunities.title: Honest handover
opportunities.body: When the Assistant can't act, hand over with context, and show the reply time.

opportunities.title: One story, two audiences
opportunities.body: Design the seller and traveller sides of a disruption as one flow.

body: My work has been in complex, regulated products where trust is everything: lending at Shecluded, payments at Foodlify, KYC and transaction monitoring at Youverify.
I design for multiple stakeholders at once and prototype in code with AI tools, which is how I built the concept in this pitch.

bring.title: Complex flows, shipped
bring.body: A 5-step loan flow and dashboard that lifted first-time engagement by 30%.

bring.title: B2B and B2C together
bring.body: Marketplace checkout for businesses and their customers at Foodlify.

bring.title: AI-assisted prototyping
bring.body: Working prototypes in code, like this one.

systemsGets: Someone who designs the states, edge cases and handovers, not only the happy path, and turns them into patterns the whole product can reuse.

opportunity.title: Change Desk
opportunity.problem: Duffel notifies sellers of changes from 300+ airlines, but only 20+ can be accepted in one click; other changes still go to support by email, while the flight gets closer.
opportunity.solution: One queue sorted by departure and labelled by action, with one-click accept, an Assistant-drafted message, and a pre-filled, tracked hand-off to support.

firstWeek.intro: My first week would focus on how sellers and travellers experience disruptions today, then contributing one useful improvement with the team.

days.body: Meet product, engineering and operations. Learn the AI support roadmap and how the Assistant hands over today.
Review disruption tickets, Assistant conversations and handover data.
Agree on one moment to improve, grounded in evidence.
Prototype it in code and review failure states with an engineer.
Share findings, the prototype, the trade-offs and a test plan with sellers.

ask: I'd love to bring complex-product and AI-assisted design experience to Duffel's AI support product.
